turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need to change my upcoming flight from Newark on May 21. I’d like to switch to a nonstop flight on the same day if possible. My mother is very sick and I need to get home sooner to take care of her. Can you help me with this?

I can help you with changing your flight. To get started, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for your current booking. If you don’t know your reservation ID, please provide your user ID and I can help locate it for you.

Could you please provide your user ID?
Sure, my user ID is ivan_rossi_8555. I don’t have my reservation ID handy right now.

Your upcoming flight from Newark on May 21 is under reservation OWZ4XL. This reservation is for a one-way trip from Newark (EWR) to Los Angeles (LAX) with a layover in Miami (MIA).

Since you are booked in basic economy, please note that basic economy flights cannot be modified according to policy. If you need to travel sooner or on a different flight, you would need to cancel and rebook.

Would you like to proceed with canceling this reservation and booking a new nonstop flight from Newark to Los Angeles on May 21? If so, please let me know your reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons).

I really don’t want to buy a new ticket if I can avoid it. Is there any way I can upgrade my ticket to regular economy so I can change to a nonstop flight instead? I’m willing to pay extra for the upgrade, but I’d like to keep the total change cost under $100 if possible. My main reason is that my mother is very sick and I need to get home sooner.

Thank you for explaining your situation. According to policy, you are allowed to change your cabin class from basic economy to economy, which would then allow you to modify your flights—including switching to a nonstop flight. However, please note:

- The cabin class must be changed for all passengers in the reservation.
- After upgrading to economy, you can then change your flights.
- The total cost for the upgrade and flight change will depend on the current prices for economy class and the new flight.
- If the total price difference is under $100, you can proceed; otherwise, you will need to decide if you want to continue.

Would you like me to check the available nonstop economy flights from Newark to Los Angeles on May 21 and provide you with the price difference for upgrading and changing your reservation?

Yes, please check the available nonstop economy flights from Newark to Los Angeles on May 21 and let me know what the total price difference would be for upgrading and changing my reservation. I’d really appreciate it if you could keep it under $100 if possible.

There is a nonstop economy flight available from Newark (EWR) to Los Angeles (LAX) on May 21:

- Flight HAT041: Departs 07:00 AM, Arrives 12:30 PM
- Economy class price: $136 per passenger

To calculate the total price difference for upgrading your reservation (3 passengers) from basic economy to economy and switching to this nonstop flight, I’ll need to compare your original total fare with the new total fare.

Would you like me to proceed with this calculation and show you the exact price difference before you decide?
Yes, please go ahead and calculate the exact price difference for upgrading and switching to that nonstop flight. I’d like to see the total before making a final decision.

The total price for upgrading all three passengers to economy and switching to the nonstop flight would actually be $114 less than your original booking. This means you would receive a refund of $114 if you proceed with the upgrade and flight change.

Would you like to confirm and proceed with upgrading your reservation to economy and switching to the nonstop flight HAT041 on May 21? If yes, please let me know your preferred refund method (credit card or one of your gift cards on file).

That sounds perfect! Yes, please go ahead and upgrade my reservation to economy and switch us to the nonstop flight HAT041 on May 21. For the refund, please put it back on my credit card. Thank you so much for your help!

Your reservation has been successfully upgraded to economy class and switched to the nonstop flight HAT041 from Newark to Los Angeles on May 21. You will receive a refund of $114 to your credit card ending in 1777 within 5 to 7 business days.

If you need to add checked bags or have any other requests, please let me know. Safe travels, and I hope your mother feels better soon.

Thank you so much for your help and the kind words. That’s all I needed for now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
